cases.speaker: Srijani Ghosh
cases.context_paraphrase: Indoor herb owner asks whether new self-watering pots suit rosemary and absences of one or two weeks.

requirements: Watering approach must suit the plant

must_not_conclude: An answerer's suggested workaround is this customer's actual behavior

cases.speaker: Torben Gundtofte-Bruun
cases.context_paraphrase: Initial bottle emptied too fast; a later retry with pre-wet soil worked. Same author, same evolving incident, not two customers.

needs: Keep balcony plants watered while away without high expenditure
contrary: Original workaround failure was subsequently resolved

must_not_conclude: Willingness to pay for a new product

cases.speaker: benk0099
